items.title: ASIC launches investigation into collapsed Bathla Group
items.summary: Corporate regulator ASIC launches a formal investigation into collapsed property giant Bathla Group, which owes creditors at least $3.4 billion.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Pops, Finance Play Hits Buy Zone; Details Emerge On Jensen Huang Probe (Live Coverage)
items.summary: The Dow Jones index rallies 500 points Monday as oil prices drop. Nvidia stock dives on the probe into CEO Jensen Huang.

items.title: Boeing to cut 5% of commercial airplane workers as production increase takes longer than expected
items.summary: Boeing has been working to stabilize production rates of its bestselling 737 Max planes, which are made outside of Seattle.

aus.headline: ASIC Probes Bathla Collapse
aus.body: The corporate watchdog has opened a formal probe into the failed property developer.
aus.why: The failed developer owes creditors at least $3.4b.

us.headline: Dow Jumps 500 As Nvidia Sinks
us.body: The Dow gained 500 points on Monday while Nvidia shares slid amid a probe into its CEO.
us.why: Falling oil prices helped lift US shares overnight.

biz.headline: Boeing To Cut 5% Of Jet Staff
biz.body: Boeing is cutting 5% of its commercial plane workforce as a production lift runs slow.
biz.why: Boeing is still working to steady 737 Max output rates.
